description: Generate a Shoot Board brief: publishes its automation drafts, then starts one workflow run per look, charged per run. Spends credits: call it only after the user has seen the brief's looks and credit quote (get_brief) and agreed in chat. Pass the board's brief_revision (read_shoot_board) as expected_brief_revision and a fresh idempotency_key; the same idempotency_key never publishes, runs or charges twice. Follow the runs with mcp_brief_runs.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_brief_revision.description: The board's brief_revision shown with this brief.

expected_total_credits.description: The quote's total_credits the user saw.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key for one Generate tap: never runs or charges twice.

name: confirm_brief
title: Generate Brief
